source.note: Paula's second painting, Fri 10/30, with a larger monitor and more detail on the calendar, phone, coffee and letter tray. Kept outside git in art/source/. Object boxes are percent of this image, measured on a 1 percent grid. The bigger monitor partly covers the bottom frame, as Paula chose.

phone.note: Phones show this crop, plus a band repeating the desk front edge under the painting so the dock never covers the drawer pull. Widened for art-v2 so the mug at 25.9 and the cards at 73.4 stay whole.

canvas.units: the phone canvas, in pixels of the source

dock_band.note: percent of the phone canvas, nothing live

objects.note: The monitor covers its lower left, so the tap area is the part above the monitor

desktop_only.note: Paula's idea: the right-wall frame doubles as a screen on desktop, after the freeze

frame_large.note: The canvas opening inside the black liner, measured Fri 10/30. Wall pieces are drawn here, over the painting.

frame_small.note: Measured the same way. The monitor covers its lower left, so the piece is clipped at the monitor's edge.

screen.note: The monitor's dark glass inside the bezel. The time, headline and Tap to open are drawn here.

calendar.note: Corners of the blank calendar page, x and y in percent of the source. Today's date is drawn on it, below the rings.
